feeds.title: Shepherd Express
feeds.description: Shepherd Express is Milwaukee's alternative news source covering arts & entertainment, culture and dining. With over 300,000 readers Shepherd Express is regarded as Milwaukee's most popular and dependable cultural guide. Visit the Milwaukee Music blog to read the latest coverage on music.

feeds.title: EAST SIDE VIBES
feeds.description: Welcome to the East Side Vibes blog! This site will be covering all types of music, New or classic, with a focus on independent or local artists from the Midwest! Keep up with the latest music releases and get interesting song recommendations. Get to know about rising artists and announcements from the best in the industry.

feeds.title: OnMilwaukee » Music
feeds.description: OnMilwaukee is a highly engaged, all-digital, award-winning entertainment publication, which illuminates everything from local personalities, news, and events, to national pop culture moments. The team of 20 committed professionals is passionate and committed to delivering great stories with cutting-edge presentations.

feeds.title: AM, Then FM
feeds.description: AM, Then FM is a blog for mp3s from the author, Jeff Ash's collection, taken from vinyl whenever possible. This blog is intended for education, a place for him to tell stories and write about music and cultural history. Jeff Ash is a retired professional writer, editor, and researcher.

feeds.title: The Well-Tempered Ear
feeds.description: Read the latest articles about music and musicians in The Well-Tempered Ear. Jacob Stockinger is a well-regarded music critic, arts journalist, classical pianist and WPR listener who writes The Well-Tempered Ear, an interactive blog. 'The Ear' covers the Madison-area classical music scene and other topics of interest to the classical community while fostering a thought-provoking dialogue with readers.

feeds.title: Milwaukee Record » Music
feeds.description: Music, culture, and gentle sarcasm are what you can find on the Milwaukee Record. Milwaukee Record is your source for smart, opinionated, and irreverent coverage of all things Milwaukee. Visit the website to learn about the latest in Milwaukee music.

feeds.title: Tone Madison » Music
feeds.description: Tone Madison provides deeper perspectives on Madison-area music: shows, new releases, and big-picture issues facing the music community. Tone Madison is an independent website covering culture and politics in Madison. Their focus is on journalism that treats culture in Madison as the complex subject it is.

feeds.title: Wisconsin Blues Music Hall Of Fame Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Wisconsin Blues Music Hall Of Fame blog page! You'll see various types of blog contributions and music reviews related to the blues scene in Wisconsin. The Wisconsin Blues Music Hall of Fame strives to recognize, highlight and preserve the music, musicians, and productions of blues music writers, musicians, and promoters residing in or having roots in the State of Wisconsin.

feeds.title: Crystal Grand Music Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Crystal Grand Music Theatre Blog shares articles about the artists and performances at their venue. At the Crystal Grand, they pride themselves on the intimate seating for 2000. They're just big enough to get some of your favorite artists but small enough to ensure you have a unique concert experience every single time you attend one of the shows.

feeds.title: Birch Creek Music Performance Center
feeds.description: Get to know about the latest concerts happening at the Birch Creek Music Performance Center. The Music Performance Center's mission is to provide intensive, performance-based instruction to promising young musicians by immersing them in a professional, mentoring environment.

feeds.title: Wisconsin State Journal » Music
feeds.description: Explore the latest posts and news related to music in the Wisconsin State Journal. Wisconsin State Journal is the best source for news, analysis, sports and features coverage in Madison, Wisconsin and surrounding areas. Read about your favourite artists and their latest music.

feeds.title: La Crosse Tribune » Music
feeds.description: Check out the latest articles on the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductions, stories about your favorite singers, and read about their most recent concerts. The La Crosse Tribune was founded in 1904 as a result of public dissatisfaction and distrust created by a light and power monopoly in La Crosse.

feeds.title: Isthmus » Music
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest music News, Concerts, Previews, and Reviews in Madison, Wisconsin. Isthmus is an independent, local news source based in Madison, Wisconsin. Isthmus Publishing Company was founded on April 9, 1976, by Vincent P. O'Hern and Fred Milverstedt.

feeds.title: Mead Witter School of Music
feeds.description: Mead Witter School of Music shares stories and articles related to music and musicians. The Mead Witter School of Music is a community of musicians, scholars, and teachers. Since its beginning in 1895, the School of Music has lived out a commitment to a student-centered musical education.

feeds.title: Milwaukee Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Milwaukee Magazine's spirited coverage of issues, personalities, and events has made it one of the most honored city magazines in the United States, with more than 250 national and local awards to its credit. But their real goal is to make a difference in Milwaukee.

feeds.title: Wisconsin Music Ventures Blog
feeds.description: Wisconsin Music Ventures is helping Independent Musicians Thrive in Wisconsin. Wisconsin Music Ventures is a program that was founded in the summer of 2019 by Milwaukee area musician and private instructor Allison M. Schweitzer (Allison Emm, in 'the biz'). Her idea was to plan events that might be different, engaging and exciting for her private students and others to attend, being held at interesting and when possible outdoor locations.

feeds.title: Concordia University Wisconsin » Music
feeds.description: Here you can view the archive of news stories from Concordia University's music department vocal, instrumental and instructional. Concordia University Wisconsin is a Lutheran higher education community committed to helping students develop in mind, body, and spirit for service to Christ in the Church and the World.
